(Confidence comes from evidence)
4.1The right product+

Brand, model, capacity, condition, and region must match. A cheaper different variant belongs in a separate comparison.

4.2The real seller+

Check identity, relevant reviews, manufacturer-backed authorization, warranty, returns, and buyer protection. A seller’s own claim is not proof.

4.3The honest limits+

Online research cannot guarantee physical authenticity or a worldwide lowest price. BuyLess reports checked evidence and explains what remains unknown.

Research gets deeper when risk gets higher.Buying, paying, contacting, or reserving
needs your explicit instruction.
(Note)

Three directions.
One clearer decision.
No absolute guarantees.

Add the public repository as a marketplace, then install:

codex plugin marketplace add alfahricireng12/buyless
codex plugin add buyless@buyless-community

Open a new supported host session after installation. Plugin and web-tool availability depend on your host.

Download the release ↗Compatibility & setup ↗

Live prices require an AI host with web search or browser tools. The examples here explain the skill; this website does not search shops or buy products.
